name: bug_css_only_remount
description: CSS-ONLY REMOUNT RELAYOUTS. Two mounts with IDENTICAL html and only a changed stylesheet (#sidebar width 200px -> 40px) must re-solve to 40px. This was an xfail pin from 2026-08-14: the solver's reconcile diffs DOM structure/content and was blind to the stylesheet, so the second mount reused the 200px geometry wholesale. Fixed by wiring the reconciliation-time CSS diff (restyled: node -> worst RelayoutScope) through layout_document: layout-affecting scopes fold into the solver's own dirty sets (intrinsic_dirty + layout_roots, mirroring the reconcile classifier), paint-only scopes bypass the structural-identity DL cache and take the clean early-exit — repaint with zero layout work. The width is 40px rather than 0px on purpose: 0px would be indistinguishable from a dropped zero-length declaration.
